context: Directions Do not exceed 6 doses in a 24-hour period Adults and Children 12 years of age and older: 2 teaspoonfuls (10 mL) every 4 hours Children 6 to under 12 years of age: 1 teaspoonful (5 mL) every 4 hours Children under 6 years of age: Consult a doctor
